ordered_diagnoses: Squamous cell carcinoma of the maxilla

facts.raw_span: a 3-month history of a gradually enlarging swelling of the left cheek
a diffuse, firm, non-tender mass measuring about 4 × 5 cm
extended from the infraorbital region superiorly to the lip commissure inferiorly, medially obliterating the nasal ala, and laterally approaching the preauricular area
a well-defined vestibular swelling measuring 4 × 3 cm, extending from the distal aspect of the left canine to the second molar
Routine hematologic parameters were within normal limits
Contrast-enhanced CT of the head and neck showed a mildly homogeneously enhancing soft-tissue density lesion in the left premaxillary region
with adjacent bony destruction of the maxillary alveolus
a provisional diagnosis of malignancy of the left maxilla was made
the differential diagnosis included benign tumor, sarcoma, lymphoma, and melanoma
An incisional biopsy suggested myositis with lymphoid hyperplasia
